description:
Two reports, both answering Claude Code dialogs from another pane:

- Three `pane send --key down` in a row moved the selection once; the rest arrived after the Return, so the dialog took option 2 where 4 was meant, and a later `--key up` wrapped.
- `pane send --key down` then `pane read` in the same command printed the dialog unmoved, though the key had landed; a second read moments later showed it. The agent nearly confirmed the wrong option.

Also seen: `pane send "<long text>" --enter --confirm` exited 0 with the text left unsent in a just-started pane.

Have `--key` return once the pane has redrawn (or settled), or give `pane read` a way to wait for output since the last send. A verb that picks option N of a dialog was suggested too. Related: e0aa57c3. From tooling feedback a_2ztsfRMJ8 and a_30URmPWYM.
title: pane send --key returns before the pane redraws, so keys and reads land a step late
